note: City of Clear Lake (Deuel County) park on the north edge of town beside the municipal swimming pool: first-come sites with water and 30-amp electric on the park loop, a picnic table at each, playground and the Lions picnic shelter. Restrooms and showers are at the pool; the dump station is south of the park. Extended-stay rates from the city office. The city's Ulven Park on the lake is a separate campground. --Claude
